meta.title: The Lights Go Out
meta.textType: story: an open evening with a power cut

paragraphs: On Friday, July thirty-first, the Explorers club held an open evening in the school hall. At six o'clock, the children welcomed the parents at the door. The parents entered the hall and found their seats. A program on the door showed each part of the evening. Mia's photo show was the first performance, at twenty past six. Leo's cartoon show was next, at twenty to seven. Lily read the blog at seven o'clock.

The hall was full of light and parents. Mia showed her photos on a big screen, and the parents clapped. Then Leo started his cartoon show. He was showing a cartoon of Pip when the electricity went off. The hall was dark, and the screen was black. The hall was quiet. Pat was afraid for a short time, but his mom held his hand. "Please stay in your seats," said Teacher Kim. "Is everybody fine?" she asked. "Explorers, please bring your flashlights."

Leo, Mia, and May, three club members, took flashlights from their bags. Luckily, the Explorers always carried them on trips. The parents turned on their phones. Small lights were everywhere in the dark. The children walked to the stage. Lily had her page of the blog in her hand. She was ready, but she could not see the words. "Can you help me, Mia?" asked Lily. Mia held her flashlight over the page. "We learn new things together, and we help each other," read Lily. Lily was reading the last line when the lights came back.

The parents clapped, and everybody smiled. "Explorers are always ready," said Teacher Kim. Dad smiled and said, "That was a great performance, Lily." At home, Pip was waiting at the door with his red ball. "Did you have a quiet evening, Pip?" asked Lily. Pip dropped the ball at her feet.
